text: 这件婆罗门长袍归你了。沃伦先生花了好几分钟查看各份报价，但最终叫到的是你的名字。你领走拍品，把它折好收进公文包妥善保管。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 52
text: The Brahmin’s robe is yours. Mr. Warren spent more than a few minutes looking over the offers, but ultimately, it was your name he called. You claim your prize and fold it away into your briefcase for safekeeping.
